newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BANKS, BALTIJOS DOMINATE BOURSE LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BANKS, BALTIJOS DOMINATE BOURSE LAST WEEK.

text.p: Trade on Lithuania's stock exchange was dominated by the shares of Vilniaus and Hermis banks and Baltijos Shipyard last week, the bourse said on Monday.

Baltijos made the biggest single deal in an auction on the stock exchange worth 11.58 million litas when Danish Odense, owned by A.P. Moeller , added 16 percent to its already existing 30 percent stake in the firm.
Hermis Bank saw the highest turnover on the central market of 1.626 million litas, rising by 4.18 percent to 212 litas. It turned over 9.225 million litas in block trades last week.
Bank market leader Vilniaus Bank registered 2.45 million litas in block trades and turned over 629,000 litas on the central market, rising by 5.28 percent to 243.2 litas.
Lietkabelis was the gainer of the week in the A group, advancing by 18 percent to 2.95 litas.
It was followed by the Lietuva hotel , up 11.07 percent to 30 litas, and Kuro Aparatura , edging up by 10 percent to 6.6 litas.
Vilniaus Degtine dipped the most in the group A last week, decreasing by 14.29 percent to 1.2 litas.
